review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares four theorems and no simp lemmas, attributes, or custom definitions, so its own simp interface is small. The `simp` calls inside the proofs are `simp [M, φ, Generators.algebraMap_apply]`, `simp [Set.encard_univ, ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard]`, `simp [h]`, `simp only [dimension]` and `simpa [Ideal.jacobson, Ideal.mem_sInf]`. In each case the simp set is explicit and local, and I found no sign of a rewrite loop, competing rules or a wrong orientation. I did check Mathlib's `Presentation.dimension`, which is `Nat.card ι - Nat.card σ` with no simp lemma. Several files in this library unfold it by hand, for example Jacobian.lean:50, Node/Basic.lean:203 and StandardSyntomic.lean:168. That is a Mathlib-side gap, and the unfolding works fine as written, so I did not report it. A new `@[simp]` lemma for `dimension` could also hide the `ι − σ` structure that those proofs rely on. I did not find evidence strong enough to call it a defect in this file. I could not run Lean, so I make no claim about observed simp behaviour.
